yunet-2023mar.name: YuNet (OpenCV Zoo)
yunet-2023mar.description: Finds faces and five points on them (eyes, nose, mouth corners) in the upper part of a person box.
yunet-2023mar.data: Trained on WIDER FACE, a research data set (non-commercial terms).

sface-2021dec.name: SFace (fast)
sface-2021dec.description: Small and fast; made to work with YuNet. Recommended, also on a Raspberry Pi.
sface-2021dec.data: The model's paper trained it on CASIA-WebFace, VGGFace2 and MS-Celeb-1M, research data sets (non-commercial terms).

auraface-v1.name: AuraFace v1 (accurate)
auraface-v1.description: A large model: tells faces apart better in poor light and at an angle, but needs about 600 MB of memory and is slow on small CPUs. For a fast PC.
auraface-v1.data: Trained on a commercial data set that its makers say allows commercial use.
